Areas

Industrial areas and business districts we serve in Erode

SIPCOT Perundurai

Industrial estate set up in 2000 on about 2,000 acres, with textile processing, engineering and leather units, many moved from Tiruppur, Coimbatore and Erode city.

Erode turmeric market

Regulated market and private yards where turmeric is auctioned, graded, polished and bagged, with the heaviest activity after the harvest early in the year.

Bhavani

Town at the Bhavani-Cauvery confluence known for jamakkalam carpets, which have held a GI tag since 2005, plus textile processing units.

Chennimalai

Handloom town making bedsheets, bedspreads, towels and home furnishings, much of it through weavers' cooperatives.

Sathyamangalam

Agricultural town near the forests, where Bannari Amman Sugars runs a sugar mill.

Hiring in Erode: what to plan for

Erode's textile trade runs on a weekly rhythm. The city's wholesale cloth markets draw buyers from across South India on market days, and processors and weavers plan production around them. Many dyeing and weaving units are small and family-run, so they need workers who can handle more than one task, from loading to machine minding.

Turmeric work is seasonal. The harvest arrives early in the year, and traders need extra hands for grading, polishing and bagging over a few months. SIPCOT Perundurai is on the Salem-Coimbatore highway, about 20 km from Erode town, and some units run buses from nearby villages. We recruit for Erode from Chennai by phone and video, with final interviews at your unit.

Lifeline Placements serves Erode from our office in Aminjikarai, Chennai. Call or WhatsApp +91 99622 99076; we confirm the joining plan and timeline before you commit.

Answers

Hiring staff in Erode: common questions

Can you supply extra workers for the turmeric season in Erode?

Yes, tell us the season dates, the work (grading, polishing, bagging or loading) and the daily headcount, and we plan recruitment ahead of the arrivals. Contract staffing suits short seasons because workers can be released when volumes drop. Profiles for Erode roles can be shared within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles.

Do you recruit for units in SIPCOT Perundurai?

Yes, we recruit machine operators, helpers, quality staff and office staff for textile processing, engineering and leather units at Perundurai, working from our Chennai office. Tell us your shift pattern and whether you run a bus, because that decides which villages we can recruit from. Our service charge in Erode is quoted in writing for each requirement before you commit.

Can you find powerloom and autoloom operators in Erode?

Yes, we recruit loom operators, jobbers and fitters with experience on powerlooms and shuttleless autolooms. Tell us the loom type and the number of looms per operator you expect. Candidates can complete a trial shift at your unit before you confirm them.
